title: BrainDecisionPayload
description: Task 012 (registry v5.96): one normalized Brain decision as MarketLoop receives it. Documentation of core/brain_decision_contract.py, which is the only runtime validator. Not expressible here: symbol must equal the cycle's symbol, and created_at must be timezone-aware, at most 180 s before and at most 5 s after the check. The runtime parses created_at with Python's datetime.fromisoformat, which accepts more ISO 8601 forms than RFC 3339 date-time; the strategy pattern's ECMA \S differs from Python's str.strip on a few characters (some control characters and U+FEFF). In draft 2020-12, format is an annotation unless a validator asserts it, so a standard validator may not check created_at's form at all.
